_comment: Which reference clip carries which mood. Qwen3-TTS-Base has no `instruct`
parameter — that belongs to the CustomVoice and VoiceDesign checkpoints,
neither of which clones — so on the cloning path the reference clip IS the
emotion control. One precomputed voice profile is built per entry below and
baked into the serving image; at request time the mood picks the voice name.
The assignments here are a first guess from the transcripts. Correct them by
ear: run scripts/bench_tts.py --ab, listen, and edit this file. Nothing else
needs to change — the precompute script and the server both read it.

neutral.why: Measured and level. The longest clip, so the richest in-context prompt.

concerned.why: Frightened and confiding — the closest thing here to worry.

amused.why: Playful, teasing, a smile audible in it.

warm.why: Same clip as amused until a warmer reference is recorded.
